demux_media_packets: demux an audio, video, or image file into packets with codec information using spdl.io.demux_audio, demux_video, or demux_image
streaming_demux_packets: stream-demux packets from a media file without codec info using spdl.io.Demuxer and streaming_demux
apply_bitstream_filter: apply a bitstream filter like null to packets using spdl.io.apply_bsf or spdl.io.BSF.filter
clone_packets_for_multipass: clone demuxed packets to decode the same media data multiple times without re-reading the file
sample_decode_video_frames: decode only specific frame indices from video packets using spdl.io.sample_decode_video for faster random access
